card: Persists in-flight private broadcast transactions across node restarts by writing them to `privatebroadcast.dat` on shutdown and reloading them on startup. Transactions submitted for private broadcast over Tor/I2P are otherwise lost if the daemon restarts before they are broadcast. This builds on the recently added private broadcast functionality (#29415).
evidence: PR description: "Currently private broadcast transactions are stored in peer manager and do not persist over restarts. A submitted transaction can be lost if the node restarts before it is privately broadcast."
problem: Private broadcast transactions are currently held in memory within the peer manager and do not persist across restarts. If the node restarts before an in-flight transaction is privately broadcast, the transaction is dropped and lost.
scope_notes: Diff not provided in PR metadata. Adds serialization logic, startup/shutdown hooks, fuzz testing, and functional test coverage for the new persistence file.
summary: Persist pending private broadcast transactions to disk across node restarts. Transactions scheduled for private broadcast via Tor or I2P are serialized to `privatebroadcast.dat` during node shutdown and restored into the broadcast manager upon startup when `-privatebroadcast` is enabled.
